name: ev-charging-map-and-dispatch-static-vanilla-js
description: On-Demand Local Services & EV Roadside Dispatch using Static HTML + Vanilla JavaScript (Zero-Bundler ES Modules) and modern Google Maps Platform APIs

scripts.build: node --check app.js && node --check server.mjs && node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs=>{for(const f of ['index.html','app.js','styles.css','server.mjs']){if(!fs.existsSync(f))throw new Error('Missing required asset: '+f);}console.log('Static build verification passed.');})"
